nodes.description: Fallback function that executes a low-level call with user-supplied parameters.
Low-level call to an arbitrary address with user-controlled gas, value, and calldata.
The caller of the fallback function, which can be any external account.
Destination address for the low-level call, read from calldata.
Gas amount for the low-level call, read from calldata.
Ether value for the low-level call, read from calldata.
Length of the calldata to be forwarded in the low-level call.
Result code of the low-level call.
Size of the return data from the low-level call.

edges.reason: msg.sender can invoke the fallback function without any access restriction.
The fallback function executes a low-level call with user-supplied parameters, enabling reentrancy and arbitrary call execution.
_dst is used as the destination address for the call, allowing arbitrary external call target.
_gas is used as the gas amount for the call.
_value is used as the value for the call, enabling Ether forwarding.
_len is the length of calldata copied for the call.
ret receives the result code of the call.
result_len receives the return data size of the call.
